system.description:
This Charm grants the Sidereal an Overdrive pool with a capacity of ten motes. Whenever she successfully blocks an attack using her Parry DV while taking a Defend Other action to protect an individual she has instructed in some way in the past, or when such an individual protects her the same way, she gains two offensive motes. "Instruction" in this context includes not only characters who have learned Charms, sorcery, or new Ability or Specialty dots from the Sidereal, but also those who have significantly benefitted from her advice or stratagems, at the Storyteller's discretion.

Additionally, the Sidereal gains the ability to spend her Overdrive motes to fuel the attacks of not only herself, but also of former students (as defined above) within (Essence × 50) yards.
